meta.name: playwright-interactive
meta.description: Persistent browser and Electron interaction through `js_repl` for fast iterative UI debugging.

copy.tagline: 在浏览器中交互式调试 UI，快速迭代修复问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在浏览器或 Electron 中反复调试界面行为
copy.tagline_en: Interactively debug UI in browser for fast iterative fixes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to repeatedly debug UI behavior in browser or Electron

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 js_repl 持久化 Playwright 会话，反复调试本地网页或 Electron 应用，无需重启整个工具链。
howto.when: 当你在 Codex 中启用 js_repl 并以危险沙箱模式启动，且从项目目录运行设置后，Claude 会接管浏览器或 Electron 的交互调试。

say.text: 帮我打开本地 3000 端口的网页，并截图。
say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器，加载页面并截图。

say.text: 在 Electron 应用中点击登录按钮，然后检查页面变化。
say.note: Claude 会操作 Electron 窗口并验证结果。

say.text: 重新加载当前页面，然后执行功能测试。
say.note: Claude 会刷新页面并运行 QA 检查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use a persistent js_repl Playwright session to debug local web or Electron apps iteratively without restarting the whole toolchain.
howto.when_en: When you enable js_repl in Codex, start with danger-full-access sandbox, and run setup from the project directory, Claude takes over browser or Electron interaction debugging.

say_en.text: Open the local page at port 3000 and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude launches the browser, loads the page, and captures a screenshot.

say_en.text: Click the login button in the Electron app and check the page change.
say_en.note: Claude interacts with the Electron window and verifies the result.

say_en.text: Reload the current page and run functional QA.
say_en.note: Claude refreshes the page and executes QA checks.
